Code — next molt. Same pattern as ScopeGuard: your inline Tools.FileSystem lives at code.exs lines 289-391 (~100 lines). Replace its body with thin delegations to IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem, passing @workplace as the second argument on every call.

The compiled module's API (same names, one extra arg):
  IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem.read_file_raw(path, workplace)
  IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem.read_file(path, workplace, offset \\ 0, limit \\ 8000)
  IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem.write_file(path, workplace, content, overwrite \\ false)
  IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem.list_dir(path, workplace)
  IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem.file_size(path, workplace)
  IExClaw.Tools.FileSystem.backup(path, workplace)

Preserve your inline module's current /1, /3, /2, /1, /1, /1 arities (external callers unchanged). Use a compile-time @workplace attribute like ScopeGuard does.

Process:
  1. read_file projects/iex-claw/agents/code/code.exs with offset=7600 limit=3600  (covers lines 289-391)
  2. edit_file with ONE old_text/new_text pair replacing the whole Tools.FileSystem module body
  3. Report size delta

Do NOT read other parts of the file. Budget tight.
